run_auto_docstring_check: run the auto docstring checker on the diffusers modular pipeline blocks directory
run_auto_docstring_fix: run the auto docstring script with fix_and_overwrite to insert missing docstrings
run_auto_docstring_path: run the auto docstring checker on a specific file or directory path
find_auto_docstring_classes: find all classes marked with auto_docstring comments in a Python file
get_doc_from_class: get the doc property string from an instantiated class in a module
